meta.name: parallel-worktrees
meta.description: Create and manage git worktrees for parallel coding sessions with zero dead time. Use when blocked on tests, builds, wanting to work on multiple branches, context switching, or exploring multiple approaches simultaneously.

copy.tagline: 用 git worktree 并行处理多个分支，消除等待阻塞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常因测试或构建阻塞而切换分支浪费时间
copy.tagline_en: Manage git worktrees for parallel coding with zero dead time
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you waste time switching branches due to blocked tests or builds

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你创建和管理 Git 工作树，让你在等待测试或构建时，同时处理其他分支的任务，互不干扰。
howto.when: 当你需要等待测试、长时间构建，或者想同时探索多个方案、进行代码审查时，可以要求 Claude 创建新的工作树。

say.text: 帮我创建一个工作树，用于开发新功能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you create and manage Git worktrees, allowing you to work on other branches simultaneously while waiting for tests or builds, without interference.
howto.when_en: When you are waiting for tests, long builds, or want to explore multiple approaches or review code simultaneously, you can ask Claude to create a new worktree.

say_en.text: Create a worktree for a new feature.
say_en.note: Claude will run git worktree add and show the path.
Claude will run git worktree list.
Claude will run git worktree prune.
